script:
A YC-backed AI startup just offered job interviews in exchange for a permanent tattoo — and people actually did it.

LemonLime, a Y Combinator-backed AI automation company, promised instant interviews to anyone who got its logo permanently tattooed on their body. Seven applicants took the deal. After the backlash hit, CEO Jordan Zietz apologized on X, calling it ‘poorly exercised judgement’ and offering to pay for tattoo removal for anyone who wants it gone.

This is what the AI-era hiring market actually looks like right now — desperate enough that a startup thought permanent ink was a reasonable interview filter.
